name: PPIO Agent Sandbox

modes.label: CPU + RAM allocation
modes.note: Native CNY public list/reference quote; rates converted using fx.json. Unknown: reviewed pricing source does not explicitly establish VAT/tax inclusion.

evidence.quote: 每个 Sandbox 默认启用互联网访问,但对于需要隔离的工作负载,你可以将其禁用。

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: Default 50 concurrently running sandboxes per user (paused ones don't count); raise via account manager/customer service. Prepaid balance (min top-up CNY 10); on arrears new sandboxes cannot start and running sandboxes are released (data lost).

caveats: Volume beta has no independently published rate.
Engine cannot subtract account-wide 60 GiB snapshot allowance; apply manually.
Legal corporate relation to Novita remains unresolved.
Default lifetime is five minutes; explicit timeout/update needed for eight-hour work. Maximum accepted timeout not established in current docs.
Unknowns remain null, not free; generic infrastructure modes are opt-in alt.
Worked example assumes resources are released between active windows unless a retained-instance scenario is explicitly discussed.
VAT basis: Unknown: reviewed pricing source does not explicitly establish VAT/tax inclusion.
Residency: cn-shanghai-1 v1 and cn-beijing-1 v2. Do not inherit Novita US regions. Volumes/secrets/new snapshots need v2.

SSH (verified 2026-09-28, docs/sandbox/sandbox-ssh-access.md): real OpenSSH server in a custom template, tunnelled over WSS through an exposed sandbox port (websocat ProxyCommand); needs template setup, no direct port 22. ssh = true.
Egress (re-checked 2026-09-28): pricing.md and sandbox-internet-access.md publish no traffic/egress charge; egress_gib stays null (unknown, not free).

Disk (re-checked 2026-09-28): every sandbox gets a fixed 20 GB local disk, free ('本地存储免费'); no option to enlarge it or price for extra local disk is documented. Persistent storage has 60 GB free per account then ¥0.0005/GB-h (the snapshot rate). Workloads needing >20 GiB local disk must mount S3 (sandbox-mount-cloudstorage.md) or volumes (beta, unpriced).

Persistent storage (templates, snapshots, paused sandboxes) is billed per day (按天计费) at CNY 0.0005/GB-h above a 60 GB per-account free allowance; paused sandboxes are kept indefinitely until killed, so storage accrues. Pausing takes ~4 s per GB RAM (billing of that window not stated).

Regions: cn-shanghai-1 (v1, default, sandbox.ppio.cn) and cn-beijing-1 (v2, added 2026-09-07; Snapshot, Secret, Volume only here). No international sandbox site: ppinfra.com redirects to ppio.com; ppio.ai/ppio.io are parked landers. International sibling = Novita (separate card).

fleet.notes: Official Chinese quota document states default 50 simultaneous sandboxes per user; account manager/customer service assesses business need for higher quota. 10/50 fit published count; 300/1,000 reviewed, no SLA or verification checklist stated. 1–8 vCPU limits are per sandbox, not aggregate account quota.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: 在超时或空闲超时发生时,你可以选择**暂停(pause)**而不是**终止(kill)**,这样 Sandbox 之后还可以恢复(并可选自动恢复)。
snapshot_auto.note: Opt-in per sandbox: lifecycle on_timeout='pause' (max-lifetime timeout) or idle_timeout metadata + auto_pause (no client connection for N s); optional auto_resume on activity. Pause keeps filesystem AND memory incl. running processes (sandbox-auto-persistence.md: '内存状态会被保留,包括正在运行的进程和变量'). Default without lifecycle is kill. Available in v1 and v2 regions.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Snapshot 是 Sandbox 的一份可复用的已保存状态。它会捕获 Sandbox 的文件系统和内存状态,以便你之后从该时间点启动新的 Sandbox。
snapshot_on_demand.note: Memory included; new sandboxes boot from a snapshot (ppio.sandbox.create(snapshot_id)); sandbox is paused while the snapshot is taken; snapshot survives deletion of origin. v2 region (cn-beijing-1) only. Manual pause/resume (memory) in both regions; archive docs also describe clone and commit-to-template.

harness_api.quote: 下面的示例使用统一的 `PPIO` 客户端，基于 `codex` 模板创建 Sandbox，通过 `commands.run` 运行 `codex` CLI、流式输出其结果，最后销毁 Sandbox。
harness_api.note: A preinstalled 'codex' template is driven only via the generic exec API (commands.run 'codex exec ...'). OpenAI Agents API page = OpenAI's hosted harness using a PPIO sandbox as self-hosted executor (third-party API). Archived 'PPIO Agent Runtime' lets you wrap YOUR OWN agent code as an HTTP entrypoint and invoke it with a prompt/session id (streaming) - a generic agent-hosting runtime, not a harness API. PPClaw/PPHermes CLIs deploy OpenClaw/Hermes gateways (lifecycle/config/Feishu pairing), not prompt/stream APIs.

egress_allowlist.quote: `allow-out` 和 `deny-out` 仅支持 CIDR 的配置方式，不支持域名。
egress_allowlist.note: Per-sandbox allow_out/deny_out CIDR lists at create time or updated on a running sandbox (ppio sandbox network <id>); plus allow_internet_access=False / --no-internet. Contradiction: sandbox-internet-access.md shows a code sample with domain names in allow_out ('仅允许访问指定域名的流量') but the note on the same page says CIDR only, not domains - treat level as ip.

ingress_rules.quote: （--public-traffic 使 Sandbox URL 无需访问令牌即可访问）
ingress_rules.note: Sandbox port URLs require an access token unless public traffic is enabled (E2B-style); mask_request_host option. No IP allowlist documented. Separate 'secure access' authenticates the envd control API.

guest_firewall.note: Firecracker microVM (E2B-compatible) with its own kernel; not documented by PPIO

secret_proxy.quote: PPIO 会在来自沙箱的符合条件的出站 HTTPS 请求上使用该凭证，但绝不会将真实值注入沙箱本身。
secret_proxy.note: Team-level Secrets with a per-secret host allowlist (hostnames, *. wildcard); sandbox env var holds placeholder ppio_secret_<hex>; proxy replaces it only in HTTPS request HEADER values (not body, URL/query, plain HTTP or WebSocket payloads) and scrubs it back out of responses. No DB/SSH/git protocols. v2 region only (added 2026-09-07).

volume_attach.quote: Volume 是一种独立于沙箱生命周期的持久化存储卷。挂载到沙箱后，它会以目录形式出现在文件系统中
volume_attach.note: Beta (内测), v2 region only; quota in GiB, mount at create or at runtime (mount_volume/unmount_volume). Also first-party guide to mount S3 buckets. Volume price not published.

volume_shared.quote: **跨沙箱共享**:同团队的多个沙箱可以挂载同一个 Volume,复用数据集、模型缓存、构建产物等
volume_shared.note: read-write (Volume described as '独立存在,可读写'); concurrency semantics not documented

docker_inside.quote: Template 在概念上与容器镜像非常接近: 它可以始于一个 Docker 镜像、Dockerfile 或已有 Template。
docker_inside.note: Docker/Dockerfile is only used to BUILD the sandbox's rootfs/template (outside, at build time); no docs describe installing/running a Docker daemon or docker CLI inside a running sandbox to launch containers. Not offered: outside documented scope.

nested_virt.quote: 每个 Sandbox 都拥有自己的文件系统和运行时
nested_virt.note: Sandboxes are Firecracker microVMs (per card isolation=firecracker); no docs mention /dev/kvm or nested virtualization support inside the guest. Derived, not offered: outside documented scope.

anti_bot.quote: 本文档使用 PPIO 发布的 `browser-chromium` Sandbox Template ... 从 Sandbox 获取 Chrome 调试端口地址
anti_bot.note: The browser offering is a plain Chromium instance exposed via a CDP debug port for automation frameworks (Browser Use); no stealth/fingerprint-evasion feature is documented. not offered: outside the product's scope.

captcha_solving.quote: PPIO Sandbox 提供为 AI Agent 设计的隔离、有状态的执行环境。它支持运行代码、安装依赖、访问文件、使用浏览器,并能跨会话保留状态,而无需管理基础设施。
captcha_solving.note: Product is a general-purpose code/browser execution sandbox; no CAPTCHA-solving capability is documented anywhere in the sandbox docs. not offered: outside the product's scope.

egress_ip_type.quote: 无独立公网 IP：Sandbox 通过 NAT 网关访问公网 出口 IP：124.220.213.124（所有 Sandbox 共享此出口 IP）
egress_ip_type.note: Outbound traffic leaves via a shared NAT gateway datacenter IP in China; no residential/mobile IP option documented.

fork_running.quote: 克隆运行中（Running）状态的沙箱 ... 在克隆执行期间，原始沙箱会被短暂挂起；挂起期间该沙箱实例不可用；挂起时长接近一次暂停（pause）操作所需的时间。 克隆完成后：原始沙箱：状态恢复为运行中（running）
fork_running.note: A running sandbox can be cloned into new running sandboxes without being killed; the original is only briefly suspended (~1 pause-op duration) then automatically returns to running.

wake_on_request.quote: 如果希望 Sandbox 在超时后自动暂停,并在检测到活动时(可选)自动恢复,可以使用生命周期设置。... Sandbox 暂停后，再次执行命令会触发自动恢复
wake_on_request.note: auto_resume lifecycle option: a paused sandbox automatically wakes/resumes when an SDK/CLI call (e.g. commands.exec) targets it.

persistent_disk.quote: 当 Sandbox 被暂停时: Sandbox 中创建的文件会被保留。内存状态会被保留,包括正在运行的进程和变量。
persistent_disk.note: PPIO sandboxes don't have a separate 'stop' state distinct from pause/kill; pausing (the stop-equivalent) preserves the filesystem (and memory) until resume (start-equivalent). Data is only lost on explicit kill.

live_resize.quote: 您可以通过 PPIO 沙箱命令行工具来自定义沙箱模板的 CPU 和 RAM 规格。... 以下命令将创建一个具有 2 vCPU、2GB RAM 的沙箱模板。
live_resize.note: vCPU/RAM is fixed at Template build time (cpu_count/memory_mb); no documented API to change CPU/RAM of a running sandbox without recreating it.

agent_harnesses.quote: `codex` 模板预装了 Codex,因此只需几行代码即可启动 Sandbox 并驱动 Codex。
agent_harnesses.note: First-party 'codex' template preinstalls OpenAI Codex CLI, driven via generic commands.run exec.

own_agent_api.quote: OpenAI Agents API 让应用通过 OpenAI 托管的接口调用 Codex harness。OpenAI 负责管理会话、任务编排以及上下文压缩和恢复
own_agent_api.note: The agent orchestration API documented (OpenAI Agents API) is OpenAI's own hosted agent API using a PPIO sandbox merely as the self-hosted executor; PPIO itself does not ship a first-party API that drives its own browser/computer-use/research task agent. Archived Agent Runtime is a generic HTTP wrapper for the USER's own agent code, not PPIO's own agent.

mcp_server.quote: PPIO MCP Server 通过 Model Context Protocol 将 PPIO 平台 OpenAPI 暴露给 AI Agent 工具，让 Claude、Cursor 等 AI Agent 能够直接查询和操作你的 PPIO 资源。
mcp_server.note: Hosted MCP endpoint (mcp.ppio.com) exposes generic 'search'/'execute' tools over PPIO's full account OpenAPI (auth scopes explicitly include the cloud_sandbox resource group), so it can drive Sandbox APIs, though the page's example use-cases focus on GPU/storage/billing rather than Sandbox specifically.

egress_http_rules.quote: `allow-out` 和 `deny-out` 仅支持 CIDR 的配置方式，不支持域名。
egress_http_rules.note: Egress control is at IP/CIDR level only; no HTTP method/path-level egress rules are documented.

static_egress_ip.quote: 出口 IP：124.220.213.124（所有 Sandbox 共享此出口 IP） 该 IP 可能变化，如有变化客服会提前通知。
static_egress_ip.note: There is a fixed (though shared, not per-customer dedicated) outbound IP that all sandboxes use; it can change but customers are notified in advance.

windows.quote: PPIO Sandbox 是一个面向 AI Agent 的托管执行环境,适用于需要运行代码、使用浏览器、处理文件并跨会话保留状态的场景。
windows.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — sandboxes are Firecracker microVMs (Linux-guest only per card isolation=firecracker); no Windows OS/template option is documented anywhere in the docs.

macos.quote: PPIO Sandbox 是一个面向 AI Agent 的托管执行环境,适用于需要运行代码、使用浏览器、处理文件并跨会话保留状态的场景。
macos.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Firecracker microVMs cannot run macOS guests; no macOS option is documented.

self_host.quote: Agent沙箱采用资源分项计费模式，每个实例根据实际占用的 vCPU 和内存资源按秒计费
self_host.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — PPIO Sandbox is exclusively a metered managed cloud service; no self-hosted deployment package is offered.

byoc.quote: Agent沙箱采用资源分项计费模式，每个实例根据实际占用的 vCPU 和内存资源按秒计费
byoc.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no bring-your-own-cloud-account deployment model is documented; sandboxes run only in PPIO's own cn-shanghai-1/cn-beijing-1 regions.

open_source.quote: ppio-skills (Skill.md wrapper), openai-agents-api-executor, ppclaw-config, ppio-agent-sandbox-samples, agent-runtime-example — none is the core Sandbox platform itself
open_source.note: The PPIO GitHub org publishes only client-side skills/samples/config repos; the Sandbox execution platform itself is closed-source and only exposed via API (E2B-API-compatible, not open-sourced).

public_ipv4.note: Sandboxes are only reachable via an assigned HTTPS hostname/URL (get_host(port), optionally gated by an access token unless --public-traffic is set); the docs never expose a dedicated/static public IPv4 address for a sandbox, and the pricing page lists no IP line item. No first-party 'public IP' feature exists.

gpu.quote: vCPU | 按照使用的 vCPU 核心数和运行时长计费... | 内存 (RAM) | 按照分配的内存容量和使用时长计费...
gpu.note: Sandbox pricing/billing items are only vCPU, RAM, local storage, and persistent storage (Template/Snapshot) — no GPU line item, no GPU parameter in sandbox.create(), and no GPU sandbox docs page exists in the full sandbox doc index (checked https://ppio.com/docs/llms.txt sandbox section). PPIO's separate 'GPU 容器服务' (GPU container service) is a different, non-sandbox product line.

eu_data_residency.quote:
PPIO 目前提供两个区域的访问方式：
名称 | 版本 | 域名 | 说明
cn-shanghai-1 | v1 | sandbox.ppio.cn | 默认区域
cn-beijing-1 | v2 | cn-beijing-1.sandbox.ppio.com | 需通过环境变量指定
eu_data_residency.note: Only two China regions (Shanghai v1 default, Beijing v2) are offered for the Sandbox product; no EU/international region exists. ppinfra.com redirects to ppio.com and there is no separate international sandbox site (Novita is the legally distinct international sibling, a different card).

arm64.quote: Template 在概念上与容器镜像非常接近: 它可以始于一个 Docker 镜像、Dockerfile 或已有 Template。
arm64.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Template build docs (from Docker image / Dockerfile, cpu_count/memory_mb params) never expose an architecture/platform selector; no ARM/aarch64 template, base image, or sandbox option is documented anywhere in the sandbox docs. PPIO's own China-region infra is standard x86_64 datacenter hardware.

hipaa.quote: PPIO 目前提供两个区域的访问方式：cn-shanghai-1 | v1 | sandbox.ppio.cn | 默认区域, cn-beijing-1 | v2 | cn-beijing-1.sandbox.ppio.com
hipaa.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — PPIO Sandbox only operates in two mainland-China regions with no US presence, international site, or healthcare-compliance page documented; no BAA or HIPAA-eligibility language appears anywhere in the docs or terms.

sso.quote: 邀请其他用户加入您的团队，并与他们共享团队资源。通过分配不同的角色来管理成员对团队资源的权限。
sso.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Team management docs describe only email-invite-based membership with 5 fixed roles (所有者/管理员/开发者/基础用户/财务管理员); no SAML/OIDC single sign-on or enterprise identity-provider integration is documented.

usage_api.quote: 您可以在「费用中心 - 费用明细 - 按量账单」中查看和导出沙箱服务账单。进入费用明细页面，选择右侧的「按量账单」tab，然后下方单击「PPIO Sandbox」二级tab；可以设置「统计周期」和「汇总粒度」来查看账单；如需进一步操作账单数据，可在查询后单击「导出账单」，将账单数据导出为.xlsx文件。
usage_api.note: granularity: account-only; cost: yes; Billing is accessed only through a web dashboard at https://ppio.com/billing/billing-details and can be exported to Excel. No REST API, SDK method, or CLI command exists for programmatic billing/usage queries per sandbox.

locations_quote: PPIO 目前提供两个区域的访问方式：cn-shanghai-1 v1 默认区域, cn-beijing-1 v2 需通过环境变量指定
